jobs.title: Corporate Development Manager
jobs.description:
Founded in 1920, Eastman is a global specialty materials company that produces a broad range of products found in items people use every day. With the purpose of enhancing the quality of life in a material way, Eastman works with customers to deliver innovative products and solutions while maintaining a commitment to safety and sustainability. The company’s innovation-driven growth model takes advantage of world-class technology platforms, deep customer engagement, and differentiated application development to grow its leading positions in attractive end markets such as transportation, building and construction, and consumables. As a globally inclusive company, Eastman employs approximately 13,000 people around the world and serves customers in more than 100 countries. The company had 2025 revenue of approximately $8.8 billion and is headquartered in Kingsport, Tennessee, USA. For more information, visit  www.eastman.com .

Responsibilities

This is an office-based position located at Eastman’s corporate headquarters in Kingsport, Tennessee.

•    Collaborate with global, cross-functional deal teams supporting mergers and acquisitions and other strategic initiatives.
•    Work with internal stakeholders to develop and maintain a pipeline of potential corporate development opportunities aligned with Eastman’s strategic priorities.
•    Analyze the external environment, including industry structure, demand drivers, competitors, customers, market trends, and other relevant factors.
•    Evaluate internal capabilities, including technologies, people, products, and business platforms, to support strategic assessments.
•    Develop and own financial analyses, Excel-based models, valuation analyses, forecasts, scenarios, and business cases to evaluate strategic alternatives.
•    Apply appropriate modeling and valuation techniques, including discounted cash flow, comparable company and transaction analysis, accretion and dilution, return analysis, and other relevant methods.
•    Develop insights, analyses, and recommendations and communicate them through clear, accurate, and high-quality presentation materials.
•    Present findings and recommendations to project teams, business and functional stakeholders, and management to support alignment and decision-making.
•    Coordinate assigned project activities, including work plans, timelines, action tracking, information gathering, status updates, and issue resolution.
•    Support due diligence activities by coordinating information requests, organizing findings, identifying issues, and preparing internal due diligence updates.
•    Support integration planning and other transaction-related activities in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
•    Work with target companies, advisors, investment bankers, and other external service providers as appropriate and under the direction of the deal lead.
•    Assist with transaction negotiations and other deal execution activities as assigned.
•    Serve as a resource to teammates by sharing knowledge, analytical approaches, and best practices related to corporate development activities.
•    Lead smaller projects or workstreams with manageable risk and resource requirements.
•    Work collaboratively across the global Eastman organization to support successful project and transaction outcomes.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

•    Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university required.
•    Five or more years of relevant experience in corporate development, investment banking, private equity, consulting, internal corporate strategy, finance, accounting, or a related business function. Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
•    Demonstrated experience using Excel for financial modeling, analysis, forecasting, valuation, or business case development.
•    Demonstrated project management experience coordinating work across multiple stakeholders, functions, or business areas.
•    Demonstrated experience contributing to alignment and advancing strategic or business projects with cross-functional stakeholders.
•    Corporate finance or accounting coursework required through formal education or an applicable job training program.

Occasional travel may be required based on business and transaction needs.

Eastman is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a highly engaged workforce, where everyone can contribute to their fullest potential each day.

jobs.title: Marine Operations Manager EMEA
jobs.description:
Job overview

Eastman is a global specialty materials company headquartered in Kingsport, Tennessee, USA, with approximately 13,000 employees serving customers in more than 100 countries. In 2025, the company generated revenue of around $8.8 billion. Committed to improving the quality of life in a material way, Eastman works collaboratively with customers to deliver innovative products and solutions, with a strong focus on safety and sustainability. To support our global operations and ensure the reliability of our supply chain, we are currently looking for a Logistics Operations Manager, Marine – EMEA.
As Logistics Operations Manager, Marine (EMEA) at Eastman, you play a vital role in successfully exporting our products across the globe. Reporting directly to the EMEA Logistics Manager, you lead a dedicated team of five professionals and drive all marine logistics operations (ocean shipments) across the EMEA region, ensuring our export flows are safe, efficient, and delivered on budget.
You balance day-to-day operational execution with long-term strategy. You work closely with our 4PL partner and ocean carriers to keep them sharp on quality, cost, and reliability. You serve as the primary escalation point for operational disruptions and continuously drive improvements in both internal and external processes, collaborating closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, Customer Service, and manufacturing sites.

Key responsibilities

•    Lead, coach, and develop the EMEA marine operations team of five direct reports, creating clear accountabilities and fostering a high-performance culture.
•    Oversee day-to-day operational delivery of all ocean export shipments from the EMEA region, ensuring high levels of delivery reliability, customer satisfaction, safety, and quality — all within budget.
•    Drive performance management of the 4PL partner and ocean carriers by implementing KPIs, conducting regular performance reviews, and supporting annual RFP initiatives.
•    Initiate, lead, and implement process improvement projects that drive efficiency, digitalization, and cost optimization across the marine logistics supply chain.
•    Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders (Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing Sites, Customer Service) and external partners, serving as the escalation point for operational incidents and crisis management.
•    Translate procurement and logistics strategies into operational KPIs, dashboards, and action plans, and cascade strategic targets into clear team objectives.

What you bring

•    Bachelor's degree required, Master's degree preferred in Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, or a related field.
•    Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in logistics or supply chain, with proven expertise in marine logistics (ocean freight). Experience in the chemical industry or a similarly regulated environment is strongly preferred.
•    A people-focused leader with a demonstrated track record of coaching, developing, and building high-performing teams.
•    Experience managing complex logistics service providers (e.g., 4PL partners) and carrier relationships.
•    Strong track record in operational excellence, SOP development, safety, compliance, and supplier management.
•    Experience with SAP or similar ERP systems; strong MS Office skills.
•    Certifications such as APICS, Lean Six Sigma, or CPIM are a plus.
•    Fluent in English (verbal and written); Dutch is a plus.
•    Personal attributes: high accountability, excellent communicator, collaborative, decisive under pressure, strong relationship management and influencing skills, ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.

Why choose Eastman?

•    A full-time permanent position in the chemical industry
•    A varied role within a great team, with room for your own input and ideas.
•    An engaging, innovative environment where growth, learning, and taking initiative are actively encouraged.
•    A dynamic, internationally oriented multinational with an open culture and collegial atmosphere.
•    An attractive salary and benefits package in line with the chemical industry, including meal and eco-vouchers, a representation allowance, a strong bonus system, and a 'flexible income plan'.
•    Flexible working hours with the possibility of working from home one day per week. A generous leave arrangement — in addition to the statutory 20 days, you are entitled to 18 additional days through working time reduction, plus seniority days
•    A market-leading package of collective insurance: hospitalization insurance, outpatient insurance, pension plan, private accident insurance, and more.

jobs.title: Advanced Treasury Analyst
jobs.description:
Founded in 1920, Eastman is a global specialty materials company that produces a broad range of products found in items people use every day. With the purpose of enhancing the quality of life in a material way, Eastman works with customers to deliver innovative products and solutions while maintaining a commitment to safety and sustainability. The company’s innovation-driven growth model takes advantage of world-class technology platforms, deep customer engagement, and differentiated application development to grow its leading positions in attractive end markets such as transportation, building and construction, and consumables. As a globally inclusive company, Eastman employs approximately 13,000 people around the world and serves customers in more than 100 countries. The company had 2025 revenue of approximately $8.8 billion and is headquartered in Kingsport, Tennessee, USA. For more information, visit  www.eastman.com .

Responsibilities

The Treasury Analyst role offers exposure and interaction with various aspects of the Company’s Treasury Operations and works closely with Accounting, Tax, Legal and other Treasury areas.  The role requires engagement, project management, controls adherence and strong communication skills.  The role provides deep exposure to US and OUS cash management processes as well as global tax and accounting practices.  The ideal candidate has powerful data analytics capability, a strong growth mindset, and the desire to collaborate internally and externally to drive value and operational excellence for Eastman. Through reporting and analytics, this analyst would be in a unique position to have a broad understanding of Treasury from a foundational level and has the opportunity to either specialize as he/she grows within the department or be able to take those skills to another department as a strong Treasury ambassador.

•    Corporate International Treasury analyst ensuring alignment between Accounting, Finance, Tax, Treasury, and Legal for company initiatives
o    Drive internal International Finance and Capital Structure team to optimal financial outcomes with engagement and alignment of key functional participants.
o    Lead Tax, Treasury, Accounting working team to fully analyze options and recommend solutions for various corporate financial initiatives as well as optimize ongoing activity
o    Ensure adherence to policies and procedures as well as communication with key stakeholders
•    Manage Inter-company Loan portfolio leveraging SAP TRM, Treasury and Risk Management module, SAP IHC and In-House Cash module
•    Support special projects and Mergers and Acquisitions activity
•    Manage Global InterCompany Dividends
•    Liaise with Global Cash teams on optimal structures and key cash movements

Qualifications

•    Bachelor's degree in Accounting and Finance or other Business related degree required
•    2+ years of experience required.  Experience in financial analysis, corporate banking, treasury, accounting, or business-related experience highly preferred
